# Sabrina Miao - Extended Portfolio Summaries

Last updated: 2026-08-27
Canonical homepage: https://sabrinamiao.github.io/sabrinamiao/

## Profile
Sabrina Miao is a cross-platform developer based in Stockholm, Sweden.
Primary specialization: React Native, Electron, and TypeScript product development.

## Project Summaries

### SWOD - Swedish Word of the Day
- Case study: https://sabrinamiao.github.io/sabrinamiao/projects/swod.html
- Demo: https://swedishoftheday.se/
- Source: https://github.com/sabrinamiao/swod-react
- Scope: Daily Swedish term delivery with usage support in English, Swedish, and Chinese.
- Role: Product design and implementation.
- Stack: React Native, TypeScript, Node.js.
- Evidence notes: Multiple client implementations and active project maintenance.

### Flow Watt
- Case study: https://sabrinamiao.github.io/sabrinamiao/projects/flow-watt.html
- Demo: https://watt-wise-190d9.web.app/
- Source: https://github.com/sabrinamiao/flow-watt-web
- Scope: Energy tracking and trend visualization for mobile-first usage.
- Role: Frontend architecture and delivery.
- Stack: React Native, React, TypeScript.
- Evidence notes: Public demo and active repository updates.

### Smart Fridge
- Case study: https://sabrinamiao.github.io/sabrinamiao/projects/smart-fridge.html
- Source: https://github.com/sabrinamiao/smart-fridge
- API source: https://github.com/sabrinamiao/smart-fridge-api
- Scope: Food inventory lifecycle and expiry-aware organization.
- Role: Solo engineer.
- Stack: React Native, TypeScript, Node.js.
- Evidence notes: App and API repositories with ongoing maintenance.

### Smart-Board
- Case study: https://sabrinamiao.github.io/sabrinamiao/projects/smart-board.html
- Source index: https://github.com/sabrinamiao?tab=repositories
- Scope: Electron-based family planning dashboard.
- Role: Product concept and implementation.
- Stack: Electron, Node.js, TypeScript.
- Evidence notes: Case-study source of truth for architecture and delivery rationale.

### Jira TimeReporter
- Case study: https://sabrinamiao.github.io/sabrinamiao/projects/jira-reporter.html

- Scope: VS Code extension for automatic Jira worklog time tracking with idle detection and explicit reporting.
- Role: Solo developer.
- Stack: TypeScript, VS Code Extension API.
- Evidence notes: Published extension on VS Code Marketplace.

### Guess What - Movie
- Case study: https://sabrinamiao.github.io/sabrinamiao/projects/guess-what-movie.html
- Demo: https://guess-what-movie.web.app/
- Source: https://github.com/sabrinamiao/guess-what-movie
- Scope: Social movie guessing game for quick group sessions.
- Role: Product and engineering owner.
- Stack: React, TypeScript.
- Evidence notes: Public demo plus active codebase.
